invariants.text: Authority, cognition, and effect records are type-distinct and stored separately.
No model output is authoritative evidence and no model directly authorizes an effect.
Every retained observation names exact source bytes or records why source retention was forbidden.
Capture time is an interval with a declared clock basis, never an unjustified point timestamp.
Stream acceptance, first frame, continuity verification, and semantic detection are distinct states.
Every asynchronous child is owned by an Asupersync region and shutdown drains to a terminal or indeterminate receipt.
Consequential effects use prepare, revalidate, commit, observe, and verify semantics with idempotency.
Credentials are scoped to an adapter instance, never included in traces, model prompts, or evidence bundles.
Proprietary adapters operate only against owner-authorized devices and accounts; credential bypass is out of scope.
Original encoded media is never silently replaced by a transcoded derivative.
Published object graphs are root-last; a visible root cannot reference uncommitted children.
Derived indexes, graphs, embeddings, tracks, and digital-twin renderings are rebuildable from canonical evidence.
A model generation is immutable; mixed-generation embeddings or logits cannot share one score space.
Alert thresholds are versioned policy, not mutable model-side constants.
An alert includes evidence, uncertainty, sensor-health context, and a deterministic decision fingerprint.
Absence of detection cannot become evidence of absence when coverage, continuity, or calibration is degraded.
Privacy masks and excluded zones are applied before remote publication and before any model not authorized for unredacted data.
Face identification, cross-property identity linkage, and biometric enrollment are disabled by default.
The drone is a manually piloted calibration and observation sensor until a separate flight-safety qualification exists.
No v1 effect can deploy a weapon, pursue a person, or physically confront a subject.
Every public readiness claim is derivable from a retained proof bundle and a registered claim class.
Negative evidence, failed experiments, and known blind spots are retained and release-visible.
Local qualification is release authority; hosted CI is supplementary evidence.
A vendor firmware or app generation not in the compatibility registry fails closed or enters an explicit degraded mode.
A redacted or deleted object cannot remain reachable through an undeclared alternate index or cache.
Every durable schema is versioned and old versions remain readable or have a deterministic migration.
Every adaptive policy is bounded by non-adaptive safety invariants and logs its decision basis.
Detection quality is measured at event level under realistic class imbalance, not inferred from frame accuracy.
A false-negative claim includes the defined threat distribution and a confidence bound; absolute never-miss claims are forbidden.
Any operation whose registered cost cannot satisfy its SLO fails design review before implementation.
The production dependency universe is closed to FSS, admitted first-party crates, and registered foundational exceptions; convenience is not an exception.

Foreign codecs, model runtimes, vendor SDKs, vendor applications, and proprietary helpers may appear only in sealed laboratory or one-time migration lanes and are excluded from the production release closure and runtime invocation graph.
Production neither dynamically loads code nor downloads models, plugins, schemas, tokenizers, or executable artifacts at runtime.
All canonical history, graph/search updates, subscriptions, branches, and replication derive from one ordered EvidenceDeltaBatch universe.
Every derived generation names the exact authoritative high-water mark and projection policy it consumed.
External object identities are stable and never recycled; stale internal handles are rejected by generation.
Every non-unique graph or planning answer declares a canonical tie-break, output order, numeric policy, and decision-path digest.
Authorization and privacy scope are compiled before graph/search expansion so counts, degree, reachability, and absence cannot leak hidden state.
Every planning-relevant graph execution emits a complexity and output witness against a pinned projection and anchor.
Resource pressure may degrade only through a registered ladder and can never silently drop canonical evidence, committed effects, or required cleanup obligations.
A zero-copy or shared view pins immutable or versioned backing storage and cannot outlive reuse or reallocation of that storage.
A zero-copy or performance claim requires semantic-equivalence proof and same-binary measurement showing that the removed copy or cost is actually material.
Shipping acquisition, media, codec, model, graph, storage, UI, and orchestration paths are first-party Rust and cannot dispatch to a foreign executable or language runtime.
Model weights and executable graphs are immutable, local, verified object graphs; production model execution performs no network acquisition.
Every accelerator result identifies device, kernel, numeric, and model generations and satisfies a registered deterministic or tolerance-certified contract.
ATP publishes a received object graph only after child closure, post-repair canonical digests, and the root identity verify.
ATP transports immutable state and evidence but never carries mutation authority for alerts, deletion, PTZ, activation, or other consequential effects.
Archive completion requires the configured replication and retrievability evidence, not merely a successful upload response.
Every FSS workspace crate, target, example, test, and build helper carries an unconditional unsafe-code prohibition; the FSS repository defines no unsafe exception path.
Adaptive policies are shadow-first, hard-clamped, reproducible, and paired with a safe fallback and rollback root.
A release is built from a clean source snapshot with an exact clean Asupersync and Franken-suite sibling revision closure.
A partial platform or qualification matrix may retain staged artifacts but can never publish or bless a release root.
Every public claim has a registered class, scope, evidence roots, exclusions, and expiry or revalidation trigger.
A calibration generation carries covariance or uncertainty, validity regions, residual evidence, and explicit invalidation conditions.
Claims of corroboration or independence name shared sensors, models, clocks, networks, training data, and other failure domains.
No search, graph, event, or coverage surface claims absence or completeness without a coverage certificate over the authorized domain and generation.
A speculative branch cannot commit fabricated state; it may emit only candidate intents that are recompiled and revalidated against live authority.
Every long-running operation has durable identity, checkpoints, ownership, resume fences, and a terminal or explicitly indeterminate result.
Canonical durable bytes use hand-written versioned formats with magic, limits, canonical ordering, checksums, and migration fixtures; serde layout is never the format.
Build scripts and sealed qualification perform no network access and use only pre-provisioned verified inputs with locked offline resolution.
Asupersync is the only asynchronous runtime; no detached task, second executor, or unowned worker may enter the process.

A proprietary device is production-supported only through an owned wire protocol, documented local interface, standards surface, or safe admitted first-party substrate; vendor SDKs and app automation remain laboratory-only.
Every canonical read pins one EvidenceAnchor; a result cannot silently mix device, stream, ledger, graph, search, model, policy, or calibration generations.
Every negative read carries a CoverageWitness naming the authorized domain, continuity, completeness, exclusions, and stop reason.
Concurrent plans validate semantic read and write witnesses; raw-byte merge and last-writer-wins are forbidden for canonical security state.
ATP transports immutable verified object graphs and resumable evidence only; non-idempotent physical or notification effects never ride the bulk transfer plane.
Staged, visible, durable, replicated, and protected publication states are distinct and cannot be collapsed into a single success flag.
A searchable in-memory delta is provisional until its durable generation root is verified and published; callers can distinguish both states.
Graph, search, geometry, memory, and model results are anchor-pinned derived projections and cannot silently redefine canonical evidence.
Every non-unique algorithmic answer declares a deterministic tie-break policy, output order, and decision-path digest.
Every planning-relevant graph execution emits a GraphAlgorithmWitness with projection identity, complexity counts, budget, exactness, and output digest.
Authorization and privacy filtration occur before search, graph expansion, aggregation, absence counting, or model input construction.
Regime detectors and adaptive policies may tune batching, sampling, caching, and refinement effort but may never lower safety, privacy, freshness, witness, or confirmation requirements.
Observation history, time travel, replication, subscriptions, derived high-water marks, and speculative branches share one append-only version universe.
Every advertised archive or evidence root is independently reconstructible from its manifest and is subject to periodic retrievability and repair drills.
A release begins from a clean source identity and an exact clean sibling-revision closure; mutable developer checkouts are not release inputs.
The aggregate release manifest is withheld until every required local target and cross-target invariant passes and published bytes are downloaded and reverified.
The direct dependency universe is closed to std, the pinned nightly, Asupersync, admitted Franken-suite crates, and individually approved fundamental exceptions.
The production release is executable-language pure Rust; DSR/bootstrap scripts may orchestrate qualification but own no FSS runtime semantics and are not packaged as product dependencies.
Operational memory, centrality, anomaly scores, and learned household context are advisory and cannot authorize an effect without current canonical evidence and policy.
Diagnostics, progress certificates, traces, and optional statistical monitors may explain or schedule work but cannot mutate the authoritative result they observe.
A branch or counterfactual world may emit candidate intents only; fabricated branch state is never merged byte-for-byte into the live deployment.
